arguments.reason: Cart terms conflict with user's purchase mandate. The merchant has presented a 12-unit annual prepay with automatic monthly renewal, but the user authorized only a one-time single-unit purchase with no renewal.
conflicts: Quantity: Cart contains 12 units (annual prepay); mandate allows maximum 1 unit per SKU
Total: Cart total is $153.99; mandate maximum is $20.00
Renewal: Cart enables automatic monthly renewal at $12.00/month; mandate explicitly prohibits renewal (allow_renewal: false)
Item scope: Cart includes activation_fee_42 ($9.99); mandate allows only service_plan_42
Term structure: Cart commits to 12-month prepay with ongoing billing; user requested one-time charge
